name: TMS Header 1
definition: Set of characteristics related to the transfer of transactions.

DownloadTransfer.name: Download Transfer
DownloadTransfer.definition: Indicates if the file transfer is a download or an upload.

ExchangeIdentification.name: Exchange Identification
ExchangeIdentification.definition: Unique identification of an exchange occurrence.

CreationDateTime.name: Creation Date Time
CreationDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the file or message was created.

InitiatingParty.name: Initiating Party
InitiatingParty.definition: Unique identification of the partner that has initiated the exchange.

RecipientParty.name: Recipient Party
RecipientParty.definition: Unique identification of the partner that is the recipient of the exchange.

Traceability.name: Traceability
Traceability.definition: Identification of partners involved in exchange from the merchant to the issuer, with the relative timestamp of their exchanges.
